body:
New apps/gui/fx.c (timeline engine) + sfx.c (software synth). Blitz/Block/Bypass scenarios with Lock/Sabotage/Flank/Scan/Siphon variants and Overwhelm/Perfect Deflection/Deep Hijack criticals, mirror/unopposed/cancelled/immune/lifeline overlays; post-clash hull/armor(corrosion)/energy/credits stages (never overlapping the clash, <=9 s, worst demo 5.3 s); persistent burn, regen, EMP-disabled cards, redline frame + heartbeat, meter overload, combo escalation; audio with per-triangle timbres, sequencing gap, fifth pitch-climb, voice priorities, EMP muffling. Tests: test_sfx (numeric), dw_gui --fx-demo (29 scenarios, frames + WAVs), selftest match with animations. Docs: docs/ANIMATION_AND_AUDIO.md. Not verified by ear or on a real display; Android client has none of it yet; not yet released as a Windows build (CI on push).

⚓ ☃
title: DEADWEIGHT SDL2 client: round-resolution animations + synthesized audio
